class.name: PHASEAudioListener3D
class.brief_description: Represents the listener position for PHASE spatial audio.
class.description: Defines where the player "hears from" in 3D space. This node is required in every PHASE scene — it drives the per-frame listener update on the PHASE engine. When PHASE client rendering is inactive (see [method PHASEManager.is_client_rendering_active]), this node's position and rotation are synced to the PHASE engine each physics frame. When it is active (client rendering mode on visionOS), the system manages the listener pose and this node's transform is not applied to the engine, but the node itself must still be present in the scene. On supported Apple hardware, [member head_tracking] can be enabled for automatic listener orientation based on the user's head movement.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the listener orientation is driven by the user's head movement on supported Apple hardware. When enabled, the node's rotation is overridden by head tracking data.
